cars.summary: The Falcon GT-HO Phase III is a defining Australian homologation-era performance saloon. The original 1971 road test documents the refinements that made it a usable fast road car as well as part of Ford’s Bathurst programme, and the test became an enduring part of Australian motoring culture.
